integrity: All displayed general identities have symbolic derivations. Exhaustive small-size enumeration and bounded-precision evaluation are supplemental checks, not universal certificates. The previously published rigidity count is credited.
scientific_limitations: The group-valued limit holds for uniformly random bijective unary functions with a fixed number of at least two disjoint named colours. The one-colour boundary differs. Fixed-cycle Poisson limits and the rigidity generating function are previously known. Historical originality is assessed only against materially examined sources; the full 2026 motivating paper was partially inaccessible. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
title: A finite-group limit law for coloured unary permutations
